title: docs: MCP_SERVER.md's Parameters blocks for six tools drift from their registered inputSchemas: release_resource omits the ifHolderWorkerId/ifAcquiredAt preconditions, set_task_status omits workerId (its NOT_ALLOWED role gate) and its status enum, check_approval omits workerId, get_pending_questions omits includeArchived, create_task types status as a bare string though createTask.ts refuses all but six values, and create_team's role union drops 'governor'
description:
Filed by hunt #24 (task-53801f5d, architect-cd0ac706) on 2026-11-04. It comes from a scripted diff of every registered tool's inputSchema against its `### moe.<tool>` Parameters block in docs/MCP_SERVER.md. The schemas come from getTools(), built in a git-archive snapshot of 1fef1b76, the moe/work-2026-10-24 tip after acb1c766.

PROBLEM. Six sections document fewer parameters, or fewer enum values, than the tool accepts. A reader of the contract cannot find the guard, the role gate or the allowed values: the tools/list schema says one thing, and MCP_SERVER.md, which CLAUDE.md names as the contract, says another.

EVIDENCE: schema or handler file:line (under packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/), then the doc line, at 1fef1b76.
1. moe.release_resource:
   - releaseResource.ts:24 declares ifHolderWorkerId, and :25 declares ifAcquiredAt.
   - :67-108 enforce them as compare-and-swap preconditions. On a mismatch nothing is released, and INVALID_STATE names the current holder (invalidState, util/errors.ts:139).
   - docs/MCP_SERVER.md:3066-3075 lists only resourceId, workerId, taskId and force, and its Notes (:3089-3094) never name the two preconditions.
   - No file in docs/, .moe/roles/ or .moe/skills/ mentions either name.
2. moe.set_task_status:
   - setTaskStatus.ts:76 types status as an enum of the 8 VALID_STATUSES, and :81 declares workerId.
   - :105-113 refuse NOT_ALLOWED ("architect or governor role required … ask a governor in #governors") when the workerId resolves to neither role. An absent workerId key is the human path.
   - docs/MCP_SERVER.md:1651 reads `{ taskId: string, status: string, reason?: string }`, and the section never states the gate.
3. moe.check_approval: checkApproval.ts:13 declares workerId (touchWorker at :22, nextAction args at :28-33). docs/MCP_SERVER.md:417 reads `{ taskId: string }`.
4. moe.get_pending_questions: getPendingQuestions.ts:45-48 declares includeArchived (default false), which :122-123 honour. docs/MCP_SERVER.md:2516-2523 lists only epicId, limit, maxQuestionsPerTask and maxContentChars.
5. moe.create_task:
   - createTask.ts:38 enumerates BACKLOG, PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL, WORKING, REVIEW and DONE.
   - :76-78 refuse any other value with INVALID_INPUT, so a BLOCKED or ARCHIVED task cannot be created. :174 defaults to BACKLOG.
   - docs/MCP_SERVER.md:1850 reads `status?: string`, with no values and no default.
6. moe.create_team: createTeam.ts:7 VALID_ROLES is architect, worker, qa and governor (schema :17, validated :40-41). docs/MCP_SERVER.md:2426 reads `role?: 'architect' | 'worker' | 'qa'`.

SCRIPTED DIFF, re-run at 1fef1b76. Scripts, outputs and a README are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt24/.
node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt24/parity-mcp.mjs /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt24/tools-1fef1b76.json docs/MCP_SERVER.md --check moe.release_resource,moe.set_task_status,moe.check_approval,moe.get_pending_questions,moe.create_task,moe.create_team
It prints the following and exits 1:
moe.release_resource: schema-key-undocumented ifHolderWorkerId; schema-key-undocumented ifAcquiredAt
moe.set_task_status: enum-schema-only status; schema-key-undocumented workerId
moe.check_approval: schema-key-undocumented workerId
moe.get_pending_questions: schema-key-undocumented includeArchived
moe.create_task: enum-schema-only status
moe.create_team: enum-mismatch role
PARITY-FAIL 8

FIX DIRECTION. Docs, plus two test cases.
- In each of the six sections, list every inputSchema property in the Parameters block, with its literal union and its `?`. Write them from the source, not from this text.
- For each enforced behaviour, add one sentence or Notes bullet:
  - release_resource: the two preconditions, and their INVALID_STATE refusal with nothing released;
  - set_task_status: the NOT_ALLOWED role gate, and its workerId-less human path;
  - create_task: the six creatable statuses, the default BACKLOG, and INVALID_INPUT for any other status;
  - create_team: governor teams.
- No test pins two of these behaviours, so add one case each:
  - getPendingQuestions.test.ts: an ARCHIVED task's unanswered human comment is left out by default and returned with includeArchived: true;
  - createTask.test.ts: status 'BLOCKED' is refused with INVALID_INPUT and writes no task, and an omitted status creates a BACKLOG task.

NOT IN SCOPE.
- Every other MCP_SERVER.md section, including those CQ-M07v2 (task-63674531) holds: get_context, start_step, claim_next_task, wait_for_task, report_blocked, release_task, complete_task's Strict completion, the new tool sections after heartbeat, and Plugin WebSocket Messages.
- docs/SCHEMA.md, which has its own hunt #24 row.
- Any change to tool code or schemas.

VERIFICATION.
- From the worktree root, run `npm run lint` and the --check command above. Both run in place and are read-only.
- Then run the six tools' tests in a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout, under env -i with Linux node 24: npm ci, then `npx vitest run src/tools/releaseResource.generation.test.ts src/tools/setTaskStatus.roleGate.test.ts src/tools/checkApproval.test.ts src/tools/getPendingQuestions.test.ts src/tools/createTask.test.ts src/tools/createTeam.test.ts`.
definitionOfDone: From the worktree root, `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt24/parity-mcp.mjs /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt24/tools-1fef1b76.json docs/MCP_SERVER.md --check moe.release_resource,moe.set_task_status,moe.check_approval,moe.get_pending_questions,moe.create_task,moe.create_team` prints PARITY-OK and exits 0. At 1fef1b76 it prints PARITY-FAIL 8.

The six sections state each enforced behaviour as the code implements it: release_resource's INVALID_STATE precondition refusal, with nothing released (releaseResource.ts:67-108); set_task_status's NOT_ALLOWED role gate and its workerId-less human path (setTaskStatus.ts:105-113); create_task's six creatable statuses and its BACKLOG default (createTask.ts:76-78, :174); and create_team's governor role (createTeam.ts:7).

getPendingQuestions.test.ts gains one includeArchived case (left out by default, returned with true). createTask.test.ts gains one status case: 'BLOCKED' is refused with INVALID_INPUT and writes no task, and an omitted status gives BACKLOG. The six named test files pass in a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout.
The diff touches docs/MCP_SERVER.md only inside those six `### moe.<tool>` sections, plus the two test files, and `npm run lint` passes at the repo root.

implementationPlan.description:
Docs: sync `### moe.release_resource`, `### moe.set_task_status` and `### moe.check_approval` in docs/MCP_SERVER.md with their registered inputSchemas and with the behaviour the handlers enforce (DoD 1, 2, 4). No tool code or schema change.

Rules for every docs edit in this plan (steps 1-3):
- Edit with your own Edit tool only (global rail). CQ-M07v2 (task-63674531, WORKING) also declares docs/MCP_SERVER.md, but it edits other sections (new sections after moe.heartbeat, get_context, complete_task, report_blocked, claim_next_task, release_task, line 1), so the worktree merge-tree lands both; a shell write here would be HELD at landing.
- Change bytes only inside the six `### moe.<tool>` sections. Leave headings, Returns blocks, every other section and the `---` separators alone (checkRef 0 diffs the file with the six sections stripped against your fork point).
- Write each claim from the source at your HEAD; re-check every cited line with `grep -n` first. At 80078651 they match 1fef1b76 (no commit since touches the six tool files). The suggested wording below was checked against that code in a planning dry run (step 4). You may reword, but keep each marker phrase named here on the same line as its partner token: checkRef 1 matches them per line.
- Keep each new paragraph or Notes bullet on ONE line.

(a) moe.release_resource. Source: releaseResource.ts:24-25 (schema), :54-60 (the check runs inside the same runExclusive dispatch as the release), :67-108 (the compare-and-swap block), util/errors.ts:139 (invalidState = -32002 INVALID_STATE).
- Parameters block: give `force?: boolean` its comma (keep its three comment lines), then add:
  `  ifHolderWorkerId?: string, // Precondition: every lease this call would release is held by this worker`
  `  ifAcquiredAt?: string      // Precondition: every such lease was acquired at exactly this ISO time (list_resources acquiredAt)`
- Notes: insert ONE bullet right before `- Activity events: ...`, starting with the exact lead-in `- **Compare-and-swap preconditions**` and naming `INVALID_STATE` on that line. Suggested:
  - **Compare-and-swap preconditions** (`ifHolderWorkerId`, `ifAcquiredAt`): with either one set, the call first collects the leases it would release, the same set the release strips: under `force`, the `taskId` lease, or every holder when `taskId` is omitted; otherwise the caller's own leases (matched by `workerId` or as the task's current assignee), narrowed to `taskId` when given. It is refused `-32002` / `INVALID_STATE`, and nothing is released or dequeued, when that set is empty, when any lease in it is held by a worker other than `ifHolderWorkerId`, or when any was acquired at a time other than `ifAcquiredAt`; the error names the current holder. With a precondition, releasing a lease you no longer hold is a refusal, not the idempotent no-op. The preconditions guard leases, not queue entries, and the check runs in the same exclusive dispatch as the release. Pass one whenever time passed between reading `moe.list_resources` and this call: `taskId` scopes a task, not a lease generation, and that task's lease may have changed hands since.

(b) moe.set_task_status. Source: setTaskStatus.ts:13-22 (VALID_STATUSES), :76 (status enum), :81 (workerId), :105-113 (role gate: runs before the task lookup and any write; an absent key is the human path; '' or null is judged and refused), util/workerRole.ts resolveWorkerRole (team role, else id prefix).
- First line `Set task status (optionally with a reopen reason).` becomes `Architect/governor/human: set task status (optionally with a reopen reason).` (the tool description's wording).
- Replace the one-line Parameters block `{ taskId: string, status: string, reason?: string }` with:
  {
    taskId: string,
    status: "BACKLOG" | "PLANNING" | "AWAITING_APPROVAL" | "WORKING" | "REVIEW" | "BLOCKED" | "DONE" | "ARCHIVED",  // must be a legal transition from the current status (below)
    reason?: string,   // recorded as reopenReason, and as blockedReason when status is BLOCKED
    workerId?: string  // caller (auto-injected by proxy), recorded as the actor; its role must resolve to architect or governor. Omitted only on the human path
  }
- After the Returns block, ONE paragraph with the exact lead-in `**Role gate:**` and `NOT_ALLOWED` on that line. Suggested:
  **Role gate:** a call that carries `workerId` must act as an architect or governor (team role, else the `architect-`/`governor-` id prefix; see `moe.amend_plan_step`). Any other caller, such as a worker or QA seat, is refused `NOT_ALLOWED` before the task lookup and any write, and the message tells it to ask a governor in `#governors` to move the row. Only an omitted `workerId` key is the human path: a seat's proxy injects `MOE_WORKER_ID` whenever the key is missing, and a `workerId` of `""` or `null` skips that injection, so it is judged like any other id and refused.

(c) moe.check_approval. Source: checkApproval.ts:13 (workerId), :22 (touchWorker refreshes lastActivityAt), :33 (only the approved branch's moe.wait_for_task args carry it). `{ taskId: string }` occurs twice in the file, so anchor the Edit on the `Check if a plan was approved.` line plus the block. New block:
  {
    taskId: string,
    workerId?: string  // caller (auto-injected by proxy); refreshes the seat's lastActivityAt, and an approved plan's nextAction (moe.wait_for_task) carries it in its args
  }
  Leave its Returns block as it is (out of scope).

No new test in this step. The three behaviours are already pinned by releaseResource.generation.test.ts (6 cases, including the empty-set refusal at :102 and the peer-lease case at :120), setTaskStatus.roleGate.test.ts and checkApproval.test.ts (:47 lastActivityAt), and step 4 runs all three. Error handling in the doc text: state each refusal exactly as the code takes it (code name and number, and what is not written). Drop any claim you cannot point at in the source; do not soften it.

- [2] a git-archive snapshot of HEAD minus .moe in a fresh /tmp/moe-88ddcac0-* dir, with your three files copied in. Under env -i with Linux node 24.21.0 it runs npm ci, then vitest on the six named tool test files plus the two MCP_SERVER.md doc guards (src/util/executionContractDocs.test.ts, src/util/taskTimeBudgetDocs.test.ts). Then `npx tsc -p .` (compile only, no prebuild generators, about 0.5 s) and the parity check again, against schemas dumped from that build, so a schema change since the frozen 1fef1b76 dump cannot pass unseen.
Planning dry run on a scratch clone of 80078651 with the planned edits: all three green (8 files, 87 tests, about 10 s; npm ci about 1 s from the cache). RED on the unedited tree: SCOPE-FAIL, MARKERS-FAIL 0 0 0 0 0 0, PARITY-FAIL 8. Each doc mutant tried (a byte changed in moe.list_resources, a stray README edit, the includeArchived line dropped, 'governor' dropped, the Role gate paragraph dropped) turned the check red.
The snapshot dir stays in /tmp on purpose. The command has no `rm -rf "$S"`, because Claude Code's safety check refused that removal of a variable path in the planning dry run. Do not add one.
Red-run error handling: SCOPE-FAIL lists the changed paths, so revert anything outside the three. SECTION-FAIL prints the diff of the bytes changed outside the six sections; move or revert them. MARKERS-FAIL prints six 0/1 flags in the order release_resource, set_task_status, create_task default, create_task BLOCKED bullet, create_team, get_pending_questions; restore the named lead-in or token on the same line. PARITY-FAIL prints one line per tool; fix that Parameters block (name, `?`, literal union). Fix a vitest failure in the test or the doc, never in tool code (out of scope). If npm ci fails (no cache, no network), post the npm error with moe.add_comment and retry; never skip or replace the snapshot run. npm ci, build and test run only in the snapshot (global rail); `npm run lint` at the worktree root is the one in-place npm call.
For QA after landing: run the same three pieces in a `git clone --shared` detached at the completion sha with `MOE_LAND_TARGET=<sha>^` exported. On the control checkout, piece 0 is vacuous or red from other seats' dirty files.
